name: prompt-coach
description: Visible prompt coaching for Claude Code: lint and rewrite prompts with explained findings (/improve), outcome-grounded session retrospectives with a counterfactual opening prompt (/retro), reusable templates (/templatize), CLAUDE.md auditing (/audit), a universal dispatcher that routes any input — one prompt, many, or a file of prompts/conversations — to the applicable capabilities and summarizes recurring issues (/check), and an optional threshold-gated always-on gate with loop rescue (/coach on). All local, no scores, no silent rewrites.
